_comment: Committed verifier defaults. Do NOT put machine-local absolute paths here; override via tools/verify_config.local.json (gitignored) or the P4_MWCC / P4_RETAIL_ELF environment variables.
_comment_mwcc_native: Use the native b210 (tools/get_native_mwcc.py); P4_MWCC_NATIVE=1/0 overrides.
_comment_mwcc_versions: Version key -> compiler path for units listed in config/compiler_units.txt (e.g. {"cw3.0.1b119": "/opt/mwcps2-3.0.1b119-040914/mwccps2.exe"}); machine-local, so set it in the .local.json or via P4_MWCC_<KEY>.
